name: Shibuya Yuusuke
source:
Shuichi's immediate subordinate, B.

He is a newcomer in his second year at the company and shows relatively little enthusiasm for his work.

However, he is a smooth talker, so his sales performance is reasonably good. Perhaps aware of this, he tends to pay little attention to Shuichi's reprimands, only half-listening to whatever his superior tells him.

His private life is also rather disorderly, particularly when it comes to women. His behavior is especially bad, and he casually gets involved with women such as receptionists at client companies.

When he was invited to dinner at Shuichi's home, he took a liking to Nanami and began scheming about how he might somehow get her into bed.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
